title: A walk's Command Z undoes what it says, or the walk fails
goal: Many walks press Command Z to prove an edit can be taken back, and in a background probe that press often reaches no menu at all, so the walk goes on green over an undo that never happened. Walks that test undo should really undo, and a press that runs nothing should fail the walk rather than leave a note.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-28 while working walks-that-drag-a-clip-on-the-timeline-by-window. keys-copy-between-layers-walk pressed {do:key,key:z,modifiers:[command]} after dipping a volume point; a new expectLevel claim after it failed: 'Tutorial Sample's level line is not where the walk said: it is not flat (2.49s 0.3 dB, 3.48s -60.5 dB, 4.48s 0.3 dB)'. The key step's own note said 'Edit > Undo carries this chord, but that item is dimmed and empty, so the MENU did not run'. Replacing it with {do:shortcut,key:z,modifiers:[command],menuItem:Undo} (which falls back to action undo) made the dip come back flat. Same in a-clip-s-sound-is-linked-under-it-walk: the clip stayed at 0.86s after key cmd+z. Survey of /tmp/photonz-playtest/*/log.json on 2026-09-28: 20 of 31 logged command+z presses say 'MENU did not run' (a-recording-opens-to-watch, captions-are-one-layer, captions-from-the-sound, extract-a-marked-stretch, lens, magnify-lens, normalize-quiet-system-audio, opacity-on-a-video-shape, panel-change-can-be-taken-back, path-demo, pen-draws-a-path, premiere-keys-on-the-timeline, undo-shortcut, tutorial-layers-and-undo...). Some of those went to the responder chain, which may still have undone a text edit, so each needs checking, not blanket rewriting. PlaytestHarness.swift case .key logs frozenMenuBar but does not throw. 18 walks use key cmd+z.
acceptance: Every walk that presses Command Z to undo uses the Undo shortcut step (which runs the undo when the menu bar is frozen) or claims the undo's result
A key step whose chord names a menu item that is dimmed and empty fails the walk instead of only noting it, or the walks that rely on it are moved off it
keys-copy-between-layers-walk and a-clip-s-sound-is-linked-under-it-walk keep passing with their undo claimed
